scope: Root-cause analysis after static scheduling and Queue RuleId direct slot mapping. Diagnostic C++ and ACPy variants remain in /tmp; production runtime/compiler/model unchanged. No change in architecture or cycle traces for tested inputs.

method.sampling: One process warmup per variant/program, seven serial rotated/reversed timing samples. Fixed N step/tick calls only. No construction/loading/observations/termination checks in interval. No LTO unless variant explicitly named.
caveats: Bounded inline lists (16) and trivially-copyable callback storage (128 bytes) are model-specific diagnostic prototypes, not a general compiler implementation.
Changing several layouts/allocators can change code generation: reductions are effects of those implementations, not exact exclusive malloc/free costs.

Perf self symbols include inlined runtime/model code; queue_runtime also includes template std::function/shared_ptr symbols mentioning gfsim::Queue. Self sample percentages are not predicted optimization savings.
Phase timing inserts four clock reads per tick; percentages approximate, on a separate instrumented build. Per-operation counters and allocation interception are separate from timing experiments.
Native and Queue CPU microarchitectures differ. Native cycle count is lower; end-to-end ratio is not pure scheduler overhead.
Activation projection intentionally changes Work/arbitration counts; exact full cycle trace and accepted count are preserved in these inputs.
no_validation only removes executing context and beginRule context/id/owner checks; it retains selectedTick and Queue checks. It changes behavior on invalid usage.

ab-first.json.scope: Slots runtime. CPU191, O3 NDEBUG C++20. 1 process warmup and 7 serial rotated samples. Fixed step/tick loop excludes construction, loading, snapshots and perf control. Diagnostic variants are in /tmp only. LTO also uses lld; unity changes translation-unit visibility.

ab-more.json.scope: Slots runtime. CPU191, O3 NDEBUG C++20. 1 process warmup and 7 serial rotated samples. Fixed step/tick loop excludes construction, loading, snapshots and perf control. Diagnostic variants are in /tmp only. LTO also uses lld; unity changes translation-unit visibility.

ab-activation.json.scope: Slots runtime. CPU191, O3 NDEBUG C++20. 1 process warmup and 7 serial rotated samples. Fixed step/tick loop excludes construction, loading, snapshots and perf control. Diagnostic variants are in /tmp only. LTO also uses lld; unity changes translation-unit visibility.

projected.model_generation: Compile projected_source/model.py with ACPY_MLIR_COMPILER=/tmp/gfsim-slots-build/mlir/acir-compile. projected_combined patches are relative to projected, all others relative to base.

projected_combined.model_generation: Compile projected_source/model.py with ACPY_MLIR_COMPILER=/tmp/gfsim-slots-build/mlir/acir-compile. projected_combined patches are relative to projected, all others relative to base.

profile.scope: Current slot-indexed Release model/runtime libraries; only runner adds perf FIFO controls around fixed tick loop. CPU190. No call graph/frame-pointer changes. Three user-cycle self-sampling runs and three hardware-counter runs per program. Construction, loading, final observations excluded. Symbol attribution includes inlined code.

evidence_scripts.build.py:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,concurrent.futures,json,sys
out=Path('/tmp/gfsim-slots-analysis')
variants=sys.argv[1:] or ['base','containers','inline_revise','no_stats','no_validation','direct_counts','unity','lto','combined']
def build(name):
 d=out/name; flags=['/home/lc/opt/pycircuit-dev/bin/c++','-std=gnu++20','-O3','-DNDEBUG','-I'+str(d)]
 if name in ['lto','combined_lto']:flags+=['-flto=thin','-fuse-ld=lld']
 if name=='unity':
  (d/'unity.cpp').write_text('#include "model.cpp"\n#include "simulator.cpp"\n#include "../runner.cpp"\n')
  sources=[d/'unity.cpp']
 else:sources=[out/'runner.cpp',d/'model.cpp',d/'simulator.cpp']
 cmd=flags+list(map(str,sources))+['-o',str(d/'bench')]
 p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True)
 (d/'build.log').write_text(p.stdout+p.stderr);(d/'build-command.json').write_text(json.dumps(cmd,indent=2)+'\n')
 if p.returncode:raise RuntimeError(name+': '+p.stderr[-6000:])
 return name
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
 for f in concurrent.futures.as_completed([pool.submit(build,n) for n in variants]):print('built',f.result(),flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import shutil

shutil.copy2(out/'counters/runner.cpp',d/'runner.cpp')
p=d/'simulator.cpp';t=p.read_text().replace('#include <gfsim/simulator.hpp>','#include <gfsim/simulator.hpp>\n#include <chrono>')

import os, subprocess, json, collections, statistics, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from pycircuit.examples.skyzh_ooo.oracle import interpret, load_image
out=Path('/tmp/gfsim-slots-analysis/profile')
env=dict(os.environ,LD_LIBRARY_PATH='/home/lc/opt/gcc14/lib')
programs=[('window',61486,40991),('branches',24662,12328)]
all_results={'scope':'Current slot-indexed Release model/runtime libraries; only runner adds perf FIFO controls around fixed tick loop. CPU190. No call graph/frame-pointer changes. Three user-cycle self-sampling runs and three hardware-counter runs per program. Construction, loading, final observations excluded. Symbol attribution includes inlined code.', 'programs':{}}
for program,cycles,native_cycles in programs:
    oracle=interpret(load_image(Path('/tmp/gfsim-static-skyzh-benchmark')/(program+'.hex')),trace=False)
    runs=[]
    for mode,variant,repeats in [('record','static',3),('stat','static',3),('stat','reference',3)]:
        for rep in range(repeats):
            base=out/f'{program}-{variant}-{mode}-{rep}'
            for ext in ['ctl','ack']:
                p=Path(str(base)+'.'+ext)
                if p.exists():p.unlink()
                os.mkfifo(p)
            runenv=dict(env,PROFILE_FIFO=str(base))
            cmd=['perf',mode,'--delay=-1',f'--control=fifo:{base}.ctl,{base}.ack']
            if mode=='record':cmd+=['-e','cycles:u','-F','9999','-o',str(base)+'.data']
            else:cmd+=['-e','cycles:u,instructions:u,branches:u,branch-misses:u,cache-references:u,cache-misses:u','-x',',','-o',str(base)+'.csv']
            exe=out/'bench' if variant=='static' else Path('/tmp/acpy-ooo-profile/reference/bench')
            cmd+=['--','taskset','-c','190',str(exe),f'/tmp/gfsim-static-skyzh-benchmark/{program}.hex','1000000','--fixed',str(cycles if variant=='static' else native_cycles)]
            if variant=='static':cmd+=['--benchmark']
            p=subprocess.run(cmd,env=runenv,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=60)
            Path(str(base)+'.stdout').write_text(p.stdout);Path(str(base)+'.stderr').write_text(p.stderr)
            if p.returncode:raise RuntimeError((cmd,p.stderr))
            row=json.loads(p.stdout)
            assert row['stopped']
            for key in ['registers','memory_changes']:assert row[key]==oracle[key],(program,variant,key)
            result={'variant':variant,'mode':mode,'repetition':rep,'output':row}
            if mode=='record':
                p=subprocess.run(['perf','report','--stdio','-i',str(base)+'.data','--no-children','-g','none','--percent-limit','0','-t','|','--sort','symbol,dso'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
                Path(str(base)+'.report').write_text(p.stdout)
                cats=collections.defaultdict(float);symbols=[]
                for line in p.stdout.splitlines():
                    cols=[c.strip() for c in line.split('|')]
                    if len(cols)<3 or not cols[0].endswith('%'):continue
                    pct=float(cols[0][:-1]);sym=cols[1];dso=cols[2]
                    if 'Simulator::' in sym or 'ResourceBase::' in sym or 'QueueBase::' in sym:cat='scheduler'
                    elif 'gfsim::Queue<' in sym:cat='queue_runtime'
                    elif 'ac_generated::' in sym:cat='generated_model_and_inlined_runtime'
                    elif dso=='libc.so.6':cat='libc'
                    elif dso.startswith('libstdc++'):cat='libstdc++'
                    else:cat='other'
                    cats[cat]+=pct;symbols.append({'percent':pct,'symbol':sym,'dso':dso,'category':cat})
                result.update(categories=dict(cats),symbols=symbols)
            else:
                counters={}
                for line in Path(str(base)+'.csv').read_text().splitlines():
                    cs=line.split(',')
                    if len(cs)>2:
                        try:counters[cs[2]]=float(cs[0])
                        except ValueError:pass
                result['counters']=counters
            runs.append(result)
            print(program,variant,mode,rep,result.get('categories',result.get('counters')),flush=True)
    all_results['programs'][program]={'instructions':oracle['instructions'],'queue_cycles':cycles,'native_cycles':native_cycles,'runs':runs}
    (out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(all_results,indent=2)+'\n')
